agent-runtime-tokens

3 API(s)
POST/api/agent-runtime/tokens🔒 auth · manual
SDK / service
agent-runtime-tokensW6 · test wave
Epic
—
Feature
—
Scenario(s)
—
Testability
manual — FR-ART-1..3 capability-token mint requires real agent_id (FK to agents.agent_definition), acting_persona_id (FK to persona table), and run_id (FK to agents.agent_run). Random UUIDs from {{dynamic:uuid}} violate the foreign-key constraints, so mint fails with 500. Re-enable when the test harness seeds an agent definition + persona + run via setupScript, then captures their IDs for the mint payload.
Depends on
[
  "POST /api/auth/register"
]
Source spec
